# @iankibetsh/sh-tailwind

> Vue 3 + Tailwind CSS v4 component library for Laravel (Streamline) backends, built on @iankibetsh/sh-core. Schema-driven forms, server-driven tables, dialogs/drawers, URL-driven popups, tabs and one-click action buttons. Import everything from `@iankibetsh/sh-tailwind`.

These guides ship with the package. In an app that has it installed, read them at `node_modules/@iankibetsh/sh-tailwind/documentation/`; they match the installed version exactly. Paths below are relative to this file.

## Docs

- [Overview](README.md): what's in the package, one example per module, peer dependencies
- [Getting started](documentation/getting-started.md): install, Tailwind `@source`, the `ShTailwind` plugin and its options (incl. `popups`, `theme`, `formComponents`)
- [Forms](documentation/forms.md): `ShForm` / `ShFormSteps` — full field schema, type inference rules, option shapes, Laravel 422 errors, wizards, file uploads, custom inputs, `preSubmit`
- [Inputs & masks](documentation/inputs.md): standalone inputs, money/pattern masks, PIN, phone, select, suggest, range
- [Table](documentation/table.md): `ShTable` — all props (incl. `params` filters), columns, row/bulk actions (`handler`, `emit`, `link`, `popup`, `url`), slots/events, server contract, offline IndexedDB cache
- [Tabs](documentation/tabs.md): `ShTabs` — slot, component and router modes
- [Overlays](documentation/overlays.md): `ShDialog` / `ShDrawer` / `ShDialogBtn` / `ShDrawerBtn` / `ShDialogForm`, `v-model:open`, stacking, `useDialog`
- [Popups](documentation/popups.md): `ShPopups` / `ShPopupLink` / `usePopups` — URL-driven dialogs/drawers that survive refresh, close on Back and stack; route-meta popups; migration from shframework
- [Actions](documentation/actions.md): `ShConfirmAction` (confirm → POST → toast) and `ShSilentAction`, props with defaults and events
- [Theming](documentation/theming.md): presets and override layers, design tokens (`tokens.css` + `tokenTheme`: one-variable brand colour, token utilities like `bg-surface` / `text-fg`), dark mode with `useColorMode()`, full export list

## Optional

- [Source](src/index.js): every public export; components live under `src/components/`
